leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply forwardRef to pass a ref from a parent component to a custom child component.
Implement useImperativeHandle to define custom methods that are exposed through a ref.
Construct TypeScript interfaces to type the exposed methods from useImperativeHandle.
Define handler functions within a child component that will be exposed to the parent.
Utilize the exposed methods from the child component ref in the parent component.
Execute method calls on the ref to control child component behavior from the parent.
Access and modify child component state through exposed imperative methods.
Return the ref object from useImperativeHandle to make it available to the parent.
Handle TypeScript generics with forwardRef to properly type component props and refs.
Compare imperative handle usage with declarative props for component communication.
Modify child component behavior by updating the exposed methods through useImperativeHandle.
Control focus management by exposing focus methods through the imperative handle.
